assessment_objectives.objective: operational resilience requirements that define controlled and acceptable operation of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) during routine operations are documented.
operational resilience requirements that define controlled and acceptable operation of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) during adverse conditions are documented.
operational resilience requirements are approved by the business process owners and/or asset owners responsible for the Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
the frequency at which to review operational resilience requirements is defined.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: at least annually, and upon significant change

assessment_objectives.objective: operational resilience requirements are reviewed and updated at the defined frequency and when Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) or business needs change.
